Looking for a job where you can earn a great salary? 💸 Want to work with friendly colleagues and get started quickly? 💪 Then come work at Leerdam Crisal Glass as a warehouse employee! You will be working in a world of drinking glasses - the ones you find at IKEA! 🥛 You will earn an impressive salary of €19.90 per hour if you are flexible enough to work in two shifts. Yes! 🎉 #baanrader.  Continue reading to get more info. 👇

What we offer
- Earn € 19.90 per hour (2 shifts, with allowances)!
- Hourly salary for working in 1 shift: € 15,43!
- Various career opportunities!
- A nice multicultural team!
- Choose your own working days!
- You work together with colleagues, nice!

Who you are
As a warehouse employee, you meet the following requirements:

- You are available at least 3 days a week;
- You are at least 18 years old (due to working hours);
- You are able to work in Leerdam;
- You speak English or Dutch;
- You are physically fit to pack the glasses at a fast pace;
- You are at least available for the night shift (21:45-05:45), availability for more shifts will give you a higher salary!

What will you do
As a warehouse employee, you will work in a glass factory. Here, glasses are continuously produced 24 hours a day, 7 days a week! ✨ There are ovens that produce the glasses. Super fun to see! The produced glasses are transported on a production line. As a warehouse employee, you stand at the assembly line where you pick up the glasses and place them in boxes. 📦 You then place these boxes on pallets. After this, the boxes are picked up by your colleague on the forklift. This way, the glasses can be sent to IKEA on time. This makes customers happy! 😃

Where will you work
At the Leerdam Crisal Glass factory, formerly Libbey, you will be part of a fantastic multicultural team of diverse ages as a warehouse employee. 😍 You will never work alone, but always with one to four other colleagues. This makes for a super fun atmosphere! Everyone knows each other, mak

In Dordrecht, we are located at Burgemeester van der Dussenstraat 910. Here, we work with our Central Hub Manager Rob and approximately 200 colleagues. As a logistics employee at DHL, you help sort packages. You ensure that every package ends up in the right place. Without your help, the packages would not be sorted on time and would not be delivered to the customer on time.

You can start as a ‘packer’, where you place the packages on the conveyor belt so they can be sorted. You can start as a ‘packer’, where you take sorted packages off the conveyor belt and place them in a cart. Later, at DHL, you can also learn and perform other tasks in the warehouse.

Please note: a package can weigh a maximum of 25 kilos. Not every package is that heavy, but it can happen. You must always lift heavier packages together with a colleague.

Working hours/shifts vary between 17:00 and 02:00.

- You are available for at least 4 days a week between 17:00 and 02:00;
- You can lift packages weighing up to a maximum of 25 kilos;
- You have your own transport (car, bicycle, scooter, or you live within walking distance);
- You speak Dutch or English so that you can communicate well with your team.
- You are at least 18 years old.
- Residing in the area of Dordrecht / Rotterdam / Schiedam / Capelle aan den IJssel

Do you enjoy being on the road and making friendly conversations at the door? Get started as a delivery driver for a major national player in e-commerce and logistics! In your own delivery van, you will drive independently through the region to deliver orders neatly to consumers and businesses. What we offer

What will you do
As a delivery driver, your shift starts at the hub or depot. After a cup of coffee and a brief catch-up with your colleagues, you inspect your vehicle and the loaded orders. Then you hop in and hit the road!

You engage in a brief chat, collect any return items, and handle the delivery efficiently. After completing your route, you drive back to the depot, park the van neatly, and wrap up a satisfying workday together with your colleagues! ✅
